integrity: The numerical and classification claims are regenerated from a standalone standard-library verifier. The extremal search is based on an exact forbidden-set reformulation derived from the definition and is independently checked by direct coalition enumeration on every maximum.
scientific_limitations: The result is a finite exact classification for ternary length-three strongly \(\overline{2}\)-separable codes. It does not give a general formula for larger alphabets or higher coalition parameters, and a residual historical-priority risk remains for an unindexed small-case enumeration.
title: Exact ternary length-three strongly \(\overline{2}\)-separable codes
